entities.summary: Nicholas Briggs is an English actor, writer, director, sound designer and composer. He is known for his association with the BBC science fiction series Doctor Who, particularly for voicing the Daleks and Cybermen since 2005. Briggs is also the executive producer of Big Finish Productions since 2006, for which he has produced, directed, written and acted in licensed Doctor Who audio dramas.
